name: Custom Click Buffer
description: Buffers your clicks by 1-5 frames, with per-gamemode settings.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the buffer on or off.

frames.name: Buffer Frames
frames.description: How many frames to hold a click for after you release (1-5).

player2.name: Buffer Player 2
player2.description: Also buffer clicks for player 2 (dual mode).

mode-ship.name: Ship
mode-ship.description: Delays releases while flying. Usually best left off.

mode-wave.name: Wave
mode-wave.description: Delays releases in wave. Usually best left off.
